# SOP-P1-L2-04 Shift handover - Ring Rolling line
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03  
Related documents: MM-P1-L2-IH02, QS-PROC-02, SB-1035

Purpose
1. Provide a controlled, auditable process for shift-to-shift transfer of responsibility for the Ring Rolling line (P1-L2). This SOP ensures continuity of safe operation, product quality, and equipment protection for EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, and EQ-P1-L2-HT03.

Background and rationale
2. Ring rolling is a continuous, interdependent process. Handovers are critical points where process setpoints, equipment states, and active nonconformances must be communicated to prevent product scrap, equipment damage, or safety incidents. Retaining a concise log of parameters and actions preserves traceability for quality audits (see QS-PROC-02) and maintenance follow-up (see MM-P1-L2-IH02).

Preconditions (required before initiating handover)
3. Incoming operator has received formal authorization to operate P1-L2.  
4. Both outgoing and incoming operators are free from impairment and have completed required safety briefs for the shift.  
5. All active alarms cleared or documented and actions in progress recorded in the shift log.  
6. Consumables and tooling levels verified against local minimums per line checklist.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
7. Minimum PPE to be worn during handover and any walkdowns: safety glasses, hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves, and steel-toed footwear. Use additional PPE as required by task or area hazard signage.

Procedure — numbered handover steps
8. Step 1 — Initial briefing
   - Outgoing operator summarizes overall line status: current product batch ID, material condition, and any deviations. State of EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, and EQ-P1-L2-HT03 must be given.
   - Note any operator actions required immediately at shift start and any work-in-progress that must be completed early in the incoming shift.

9. Step 2 — Critical parameters confirmation
   - Confirm and read back the furnace setpoint for EQ-P1-L2-HT03. The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 855 °C.
   - Confirm coil cooling water flow at EQ-P1-L2-IH02. The coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min.
   - Record actual readings at handover in the shift log. If readings deviate from the values above, document actions taken and reference MM-P1-L2-IH02 for instrumentation checks.

10. Step 3 — Equipment condition and safety items
   - Walk down EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, and EQ-P1-L2-HT03 with incoming operator. Point out any mechanical issues, loose guards, or temporary controls. Log items requiring maintenance in the shift log and notify maintenance per MM-P1-L2-IH02.
   - Verify isolation points and tag statuses for any maintenance work. Confirm permits are present for in-progress maintenance.

11. Step 4 — Process quality and nonconformance
   - Review in-line inspection results, scrap or rework since last handover, and any trending concerns. Record product disposition decisions in accordance with QS-PROC-02.
   - If a quality hold exists, confirm the hold protocol and point of contact. Do not release product without QA sign-off per QS-PROC-02.

12. Step 5 — Consumables, materials, and tooling
   - Verify lot numbers and traceability for feedstock and tooling used in production. Log any low-stock items requiring procurement or supervisor notification.

13. Step 6 — HAZOP, safety, and environmental
   - Highlight any recent near-misses or safety observations. Confirm emergency procedures and alarm response responsibilities.
   - Note any environmental releases or deviations and report per SB-1035.

14. Step 7 — Transfer of controls and acknowledgement
   - Outgoing operator transfers documented control of the line to incoming operator only after all items in this SOP are acknowledged and recorded in the shift log.
   - Incoming operator reads back critical parameters and outstanding actions to confirm mutual understanding.

Examples and clarifications
15. Example: If during handover the measured furnace temperature is 10 °C below the austenitizing setpoint, record the discrepancy, implement immediate corrective action if required, and notify maintenance per MM-P1-L2-IH02. Do not resume production until the incoming operator understands the risk and corrective plan.
16. Example: If induction heater coil cooling flow reads below the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min at handover, stop billet feed and initiate cooling system troubleshooting per MM-P1-L2-IH02.

Records to keep
17. Maintain the shift log with:
   - Time-stamped entries for each handover item (parameter confirmations, deviations, corrective actions).
   - Signatures of outgoing and incoming operators and supervising technician.
   - Reference to maintenance tickets or quality nonconformance reports raised during the shift.
   These records support compliance with QS-PROC-02 and facilitate troubleshooting and audits.

Escalation and supervisor notification
18. If unresolved critical deviations exist at the end of the handover, the incoming operator must notify the line supervisor before assuming full control. Document the notification in the shift log and create a maintenance or QA action per MM-P1-L2-IH02 and QS-PROC-02.

Sign-off
19. Outgoing operator prints name and signs to confirm complete and accurate transfer of line responsibility. Incoming operator prints name and signs to accept responsibility. Supervisor reviews and initials the handover record.
   - Retain signed handover records in the line binder and submit electronic copies per QS-PROC-02.

Revision control and references
20. This SOP is Rev E. For maintenance procedures for EQ-P1-L2-IH02 see MM-P1-L2-IH02. For quality hold and disposition follow QS-PROC-02. For safety bulletin and environmental reporting follow SB-1035.
